shouldFix.title: The not-produced expected schema still admits the retired dr006-inactive reason
detail: The enum is ['preview-not-advertised', 'dr006-inactive']. After the v7 outcome repair, the sole lawful not-produced combination is advertisement=none with either standing, and its only expectedReason is preview-not-advertised.

inputOutcomeLaw contains no lawful row yielding dr006-inactive and explicitly says sarif+INACTIVE is a failed advertisement rather than that reason. reasonBinding therefore rejects every use of the second enum member.
This is the output-side twin of CLAUDE-V7-S2: the structured schema admits a value that the surrounding law rejects. The prose law remains deterministic, which keeps the issue below blocker grade.
shouldFix.impact: A schema-only golden validator can accept a not-produced expectation that no lawful input can select.
shouldFix.minimumRepair: Narrow expectedWhenNotProduced.properties.reason.enum to ['preview-not-advertised']; do not restore a sarif+INACTIVE lawful row.

shouldFix.title: The produced expected schema does not structurally require the DR-006-active parity keys
detail: inputProduced is lawful only with dr006Standing=ACTIVE. machineSurface.requiredness then makes runId, findingId, and coverage mandatory, and the local notes repeat that standing.

The structured expected schema nevertheless requires only schemaId/schemaVersion/truncation on the run and only artifactRefs on each result. It does not list runId, findingId, or coverage in those required arrays.

The global prose requiredness and pass rule still reject missing required keys, so there is no second normative outcome. But a validator executing the declared expected schema alone can accept a produced parity expectation that fails to test the identity and Coverage fields OBL-3 exists to preserve.
shouldFix.impact: Future produced parity/loss goldens can be structurally under-specified even though produced always implies the dependency state that makes these fields mandatory.
shouldFix.minimumRepair: Add runId to expectedWhenProduced.runPropertiesOpensip.required and add findingId and coverage to expectedWhenProduced.resultPropertiesOpensip.items.required. Keep verdict conditional on whether the pinned host result has one.
